notes.title: Discord channel & Beta version
notes.notes:
We have opened a Discord channel. Аny player or anyone who is interested from the Eslander and has ideas can offer them there.
We accept any ideas about the game as well as tips.

https://discord.gg/nPNNVuB <<< Discord Channel Link 

We are in the process of preparing for the long-awaited Game Tutorial and correcting all typos, etc.
Multiplayer is already functional, but important features will need to be set up.
It will also be added to the tutorial.

A beta testing version has been added, which you can choose from Steam to keep up with all the updates that are added to the game before being released in the stable version.

- How i can activate the beta version?
Right-click on the name of the game in your library.
Click on the Betas Tab
And then select the beta-

Warning: Updates will be there almost every day, there will be a period in which between 10-15 updates will be released each day, so that the multiplayer can be completed.

Thank you!

notes.title: Multiplayer Release on 01.05.2020
notes.notes:
After much testing and development, we are finally one step away from completing the multiplayer.

We are doing our best to create a seamless multiplayer with servers in all countries. That's why we decided to use the Steam Multiplayer system, which was specifically designed for our gaming engine. It will use the same settings and mode as Dota 2 and the Counter Strike Global Offensive. There will be no need to create a new account in the game as Steam is already integrated and multiplayer works. But we recommend that you do not use it yet. An additional section in the Tutorial Menu will be created for the multiplayer (usage mode). Thanks for your patience! We will do our best to reach you faster.
